```{r}
install.packages('treemap')
library('treemap')

setwd('/Users/skd6150/Documents/Research/CBI/iModulon_Ctherm/iModulonMiner_eh_combined/5_characterize_iModulons_v2/')
# Use this if PDF version is desired
# pdf("./results_characterize_imodulons/iModulon_treemap_ctherm.pdf", #file where it will be saved
#     width=16, #svg params, change as you need
#     height=12, 
#     pointsize=12)
# Use this if SVG version is desired
svg("./results_characterize_imodulons/iModulon_treemap_ctherm.svg", #file where it will be saved
    width=16, #svg params, change as you need
    height=12, 
    pointsize=12)
tree_df = read.delim('./results_characterize_imodulons/imodulons_variance_for_treemap_plotting_09132026.tsv', row.names='X') #load data
treemap(tree_df, index=c('category', 'name'), vSize='ExplainedVariance') #make treemap
dev.off() #close svg
```
